_approach: Melodigging's canonical 3-step kick timing (≈1.1, 2.75, 4.0): kick on beat 1, a kick pushed into the last 16th of beat 2 so it falls forward into the empty beat 3, and a kick on beat 4 - the clearest version of Thakzin's 'I just removed one kick, and there's a lot of space'. Swung 16th shaker, rim ghosts either side of the gap, congaLow answers where the beat-3 kick used to be. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
